title: Clematichinenoside AR alleviates rheumatoid arthritis by inhibiting synovial angiogenesis through the HIF-1alpha/VEGFA/ANG2 axis.
authors: Yuan, Meiling; Wu, Yajie; Zhou, Xinyue; Cai, Yikang; Li, Hui; Xia, Aixin; Wang, Xiao; Wen, Jianting; Duan, Qiangjun; Xu, Chenhao; Cao, Huibo; Miao, Chenggui
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药单体CAR通过HIF-1alpha/VEGFA/ANG2轴抑制类风湿关节炎滑膜血管生成，虽含分子对接与动力学，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Clematichinenoside AR (CAR) is an effective monomer component of Clematis chinensis Osbeck, which has therapeutic effects on rheumatoid arthritis (RA), but its specific mechanism is still not fully elucidated. PURPOSE: This study elucidated whether CAR alleviated RA by inhibiting synovial angiogenesis and revealed its molecular mechanism. METHODS: Arthritis indicators and H&E staining were used to evaluate the therapeutic effects of CAR on collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) rats, and the IHC, IF, EdU-Hoechst, tunel, flow cytometry, wound healing and transwell assay were used to investigate the effects of CAR on synovial angiogenesis. The co-culture model of RA fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLSs) and human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs) was established. Tube formation, western blot, RT-qPCR and other related methods were used to evaluate the specific mechanism of CAR. RESULTS: CAR alleviated arthritis pathology and inhibited angiogenesis in CIA rats. CAR inhibited the proliferation, migration and invasion of RA FLSs, and promoted their apoptosis. Importantly, overexpression of HIF-1alpha inversed the inhibitory impact of CAR on the expression of HIF-1alpha, VEGFA, VEGFR2, and ANG2, as well as the inhibitory effects of CAR on the expression of CD31/34 and the HUVEC tube formation. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics, and experimental verification confirmed that CAR has a strong binding affinity with HIF-1alpha, further indicating that HIF-1alpha was a target of CAR for anti-angiogenesis. CONCLUSION: CAR had a good inhibitory effect on RA, and its mechanism was inhibition of synovial angiogenesis through the HIF-1alpha/VEGF/ANG2 axis.
abstract_zh: 背景：威灵仙苷（Clematichinenoside AR, CAR）是威灵仙（Clematis chinensis Osbeck）的有效单体成分，对类风湿关节炎（rheumatoid arthritis, RA）具有治疗作用，但其具体机制尚未完全阐明。目的：本研究阐明CAR是否通过抑制滑膜血管生成来缓解RA，并揭示其分子机制。方法：采用关节炎指标和H&E染色评估CAR对胶原诱导性关节炎（collagen-induced arthritis, CIA）大鼠的治疗效果，并通过IHC、IF、EdU-Hoechst、tunel、流式细胞术、伤口愈合和transwell实验研究CAR对滑膜血管生成的影响。建立RA成纤维样滑膜细胞（fibroblast-like synoviocytes, FLSs）与人脐静脉内皮细胞（human umbilical vein endothelial cells, HUVECs）的共培养模型。采用管形成、western blot、RT-qPCR等相关方法评估CAR的具体机制。结果：CAR减轻了CIA大鼠的关节炎病理并抑制了血管生成。CAR抑制了RA FLSs的增殖、迁移和侵袭，并促进其凋亡。重要的是，HIF-1alpha的过表达逆转了CAR对HIF-1alpha、VEGFA、VEGFR2和ANG2表达的抑制作用，以及CAR对CD31/34表达和HUVEC管形成的抑制效果。分子对接、分子动力学和实验验证确认CAR与HIF-1alpha具有强结合亲和力，进一步表明HIF-1alpha是CAR抗血管生成的靶点。结论：CAR对RA具有良好的抑制作用，其机制是通过HIF-1alpha/VEGF/ANG2轴抑制滑膜血管生成。
